name: MoEngage
description_en:
MoEngage is a product in the Marketing automation category. Its directory profile covers Website Visitor Tracking, Lead Nurturing, Lead Management, Landing Pages, Email Drip Campaigns, Channel Management, Campaign Segmentation, Analytics (ROI Tracking).

Additional listed capabilities include Multivariate Testing, Lead Scoring. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: track prospective customers through qualification and follow-up; schedule a sequence of emails around defined timing or events; prioritize prospective customers using defined attributes and activity. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
MoEngage 属于营销自动化软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括网站访客跟踪、线索培育、潜在客户管理、落地页、序列邮件、渠道管理、营销活动分群、投资回报分析。

资料还列出多变量测试、线索评分。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：跟踪潜在客户的筛选、分配与跟进；按时间或事件安排一组连续邮件；按线索属性和互动记录确定跟进优先级。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
